abstract: Clinical and histological correlates of survival in patients undergoing complete resection of pulmonary metastases from nonseminomatous testicular carcinoma were determined in 25 Stage C patients aged 17-38 years treated from 1969-1978. All patients had orchiectomy and retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy. Nineteen patients received combination chemotherapy before resection, and all received chemotherapy after resection. Three patients had four additional thoracotomies for pulmonary recurrence. Survival was measured from time of first thoracotomy to time of last followup or death. Actuarial survival for the entire group at one, two, and five years was 80, 63, and 59%, respectively. Median follow-up of the survivors was 3.5 years. Patients in low tumor burden groups such as those with no tumor in retroperitoneal nodes, with unilateral metastases, or with single metastases had better prognosis, as did patients whose primary tumors were moderately well differentiated. Characteristics of pulmonary metastases that favorably influenced the prognosis were the presence of mature teratoma, presence of few mitoses, lack of mononuclear infiltrate, and lack of desmoplastic response. These findings confirm the effectiveness of multimodality therapy which includes the resection of pulmonary metastases for Stage C nonseminomatous carcinoma of the testes. In addition, they suggest that consideration should be given to the stratification of prospective clinical trials on the basis of tumor burden and histologic characteristics of the primary and metastatic lesions.
abstract_ja: 1969年から1978年に治療されたstage C非セミノーマ性精巣がんの患者25例(17～38歳)において、肺転移の完全切除後の生存に関連する臨床的・組織学的因子を検討した。全例に精巣摘除術と後腹膜リンパ節郭清が施行された。19例は切除前に併用化学療法を受け、全例が切除後に化学療法を受けた。さらに3例では肺再発に対して4回の追加開胸術が行われた。生存期間は初回開胸時から最終追跡時または死亡時までとした。全体の1年、2年、5年の生存率はそれぞれ80%、63%、59%であった。追跡期間中央値は生存者で3.5年であった。後腹膜リンパ節に腫瘍を認めない例、片側性転移の例、単発転移の例など腫瘍量の少ない群は予後が良好であり、原発巣の分化度が中等度に良好な例も予後が良好であった。予後を良好にする肺転移巣の特徴は、成熟奇形腫の存在、核分裂像の少なさ、単核細胞浸潤の欠如、および結合組織反応の欠如であった。これらの所見は、Stage C非セミノーマ性精巣癌に対する肺転移切除を含む集学的治療の有効性を裏付けるものである。さらに、将来の臨床試験は、腫瘍量と原発巣および転移巣の組織学的特徴に基づいて層別化することが検討されるべきである。
